blocks.text: Now listen to the account of (Baba) Phool, The way Guru's blessings came to be realized. As his household flourished and prospered, Two sons were born in his family. (1)
lines: Now listen to the account of (Baba) Phool,
The way Guru's blessings came to be realized.
As his household flourished and prospered,
Two sons were born in his family.

blocks.text: Tiloka1 and Rama2 being the names of his two sons, Another village by the name of Phool did they establish Thereafter, as the tenth Sikh Guru arrived there, He initiated these two sons into Khalsa Panth Singhs. (2)
lines: Tiloka1 and Rama2 being the names of his two sons,
Another village by the name of Phool did they establish Thereafter, as the tenth Sikh Guru arrived there,
He initiated these two sons into Khalsa Panth Singhs.

blocks.text: Thereafter, five sons3 were born to Rama, Two of them being Alo Singh4 and Avdhoot Bhoomia. Three others sons being Doono, Surtio and Raghu, Hamira and Gajpat5 were sons of Tiloka. (3)
lines: Thereafter, five sons3 were born to Rama,
Two of them being Alo Singh4 and Avdhoot Bhoomia.
Three others sons being Doono,
Surtio and Raghu,
Hamira and Gajpat5 were sons of Tiloka.

blocks.text: In whatever direction did they make an invasion, Never did they fail to achieve a victory. By aligning themselves with Banda Bahadur's forces, They accomplished every goal by getting their enemies killed. (4)
lines: In whatever direction did they make an invasion,
Never did they fail to achieve a victory.
By aligning themselves with Banda Bahadur's forces,
They accomplished every goal by getting their enemies killed.

blocks.text: From the two cities of Moonak6 and Sunam7 , No (Muslim) resident could dare to come out. Whosoever dared to venture out of these towns, Instantly would they get them killed by Banda's forces. (5)
lines: From the two cities of Moonak6 and Sunam7 ,
No (Muslim) resident could dare to come out.
Whosoever dared to venture out of these towns,
Instantly would they get them killed by Banda's forces.

blocks.text: As all clan members of Phool and Mehraj joined together, They managed to streamline all the state affairs. Difficult it is to narrate all the details, In brief has the author narrated all the events. (6)
lines: As all clan members of Phool and Mehraj joined together,
They managed to streamline all the state affairs.
Difficult it is to narrate all the details,
In brief has the author narrated all the events.

blocks.text: As sons of both Rama and Tiloka became adults, There were further additions in their families. As they gave birth to more offsprings in their clan, They were keen to occupy more and more territory. (7)
lines: As sons of both Rama and Tiloka became adults,
There were further additions in their families.
As they gave birth to more offsprings in their clan,
They were keen to occupy more and more territory.

blocks.text: It was in the year seventeen hundred and eighty seven (B.S.), That there broke out a drought and famine in the forested region. At this, all the grandsons of Baba Phool Confabulated, Must they take hold of a region rich in ground water. So they founded Balyowal, Dhanaula, Bhadaur and Shehna, Together with the villages of Adhiayo and Barnala. With the founding of six villages by the six brothers, Khalsa forces were invited there after to occupy to these villages. (8)
lines: It was in the year seventeen hundred and eighty seven (B.S.),
That there broke out a drought and famine in the forested region.
At this, all the grandsons of Baba Phool Confabulated,

With the founding of six villages by the six brothers,
